blocks.text: Cartel boss Fausto Isidro Meza Flores also known as “El Chapo Isidro” AP photo GUASAVE, Mexico — Heavy gunfire, helicopters and burning trucks marked Mexico’s Sinaloa state Saturday after authorities captured cartel boss Fausto Isidro Meza Flores, known as “El Chapo Isidro,” in an operation that left at least 11 people dead. Meza Flores, one of the FBI’s 10 most wanted fugitives, was captured and flown to Mexico City on Saturday after the firefight between Mexican forces and cartel gunmen overnight left residents of the city of Guasave terrorized.
